entries.07c0013eec60859a: It provides CX services that support customer companies' dealings with their customers, and BPO services that handle business processes on their behalf. In CX services it handles contact center operations and the construction and operation of Web sites, and in BPO services it handles outsourced operation of business processes such as clerical work and logistics. Its sites in Japan are called 'CX Square' and 'BPO Center'.
entries.0b6dab28819092ac: Provision of CX services and BPO services
entries.1bda79f47b9f45a1: It provides CX services that support its client companies' customer interactions and BPO services that carry out business processes on their behalf.
entries.1c023477f1bbfbf8: The company positions the origin of its business as “combining excellent people and technology through systems (shikumi).” People refers to highly specialized professionals, and technology refers to the cutting-edge global technologies best suited to solving clients’ challenges; this idea is expressed in the logo as “people & technology.” Since its founding in 1966, it has continued to operate as an independent, comprehensive information services company and a pioneer in information processing outsourcing.
entries.29e56f7c7955cdf6: Clients are domestic and overseas companies that outsource customer support and business processes. No single customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.

entries.6dc697c01ff7c211: The company is composed of the company itself, 78 subsidiaries and 20 affiliates (as of March 31, 2026). Since its founding in 1966 as a data entry specialist company, it has handled information processing outsourcing. The number of consolidated employees is 43,571.
entries.7f5f3f4cf359e81c: This is the outsourcing business operated by domestic group companies. It is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries, including the video streaming platform J-Stream and those providing applied software development technology. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥39,977 million.
entries.845671e291d4fcff: This is the outsourcing business that transcosmos inc. itself operates. It provides CX services, such as contact center operation, and BPO services, which take over business processes. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥254,286 million, the largest business in the group.
entries.912e4526a50e055d: It receives consideration for the services it provides from client companies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥393,866 million, an increase of 4.8% from the previous year. The largest is the standalone services provided by the company itself, with revenue from external customers of ¥254,286 million.
entries.a3ae2c63aedf0d1b: An outsourcing company that takes on customer support and business processes for corporations, providing CX services such as contact centers and BPO services for business process outsourcing in Japan and overseas.
entries.a47f95335ba218f0: This is a business model in which the company is entrusted by client companies with customer support and the operation of business processes, provides CX services and BPO services at its own sites and those of group companies, and receives consideration for the services provided.
entries.b11e9b34b37d4966: This is the outsourcing business operated by domestic group companies.
entries.b42d19e0f69a1e54: The medium-term business plan for fiscal 2026 through fiscal 2028 is positioned as “Three Years of Structural Transformation,” with the themes “Evolving the business model and turning overall capabilities into profit” and “Expanding the customer base and service portfolio toward the next stage of growth.” While making investments, it is advancing the shift to a high-profitability business model, and it aims to roll out the high-profit model it has built across the company, increasing sales of CX services and BPO services and improving profitability.
entries.b8747f929eab8ef7: This is the outsourcing business operated by overseas group companies. Subsidiaries in China, South Korea, Southeast Asia and other regions provide services such as contact centers and BPO. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥99,601 million.
